scenario: A real estate investment analyst appraises an income-producing property: appraisal-ai extracts and structures the subject property data from the workfile, financial-calculator computes the capitalization rate and present value of projected net operating income, and reporting assembles the findings into a formal investment property valuation report.
info_flow: appraisal-ai parses the property workfile and extracts structured comparable data with adjustment fields → financial-calculator receives those figures and computes capitalization rate and present value → reporting consolidates the appraisal narrative and financial figures into a final investment valuation report.
